UI consistency audit complete. **7/7 audits PASS, zero defects found, zero commits needed.** No source code was modified — the codebase is already internally consistent.

## Summary

| Audit | Verdict | Sample |
|-------|---------|--------|
| 1. Icon library | PASS | 60–1,031 SVGs/page, 100% Heroicons-outline. Zero solid/FontAwesome/Lucide imports. |
| 2. Buttons | PASS | 1,059 buttons sampled; class groups internally uniform (.auth-btn h=36, .nav-link h=42, .topbar__btn h=38). Only outlier is a deliberate 18px icon-only utility. |
| 3. Header/toolbar | PASS | All 17 real routes: 56px height, `topbar glass` class, 18px/700 title. |
| 4. Sidebar | PASS | 240px wide, 18 nav-links, exactly 1 active per page. |
| 5. Form elements | PASS | 0 native `<select>`, 0 native date inputs. Create Lead modal has 9/9 `.form-input`. |
| 6. Spacing | PASS | All `.glass` panels share `border-radius: 20px / 18px`. |
| 7. Modals | PASS | 13 modal components use `.modal-backdrop`; non-modal fixed-positions correctly excluded. |
